evidence.quote:
A rollback
we have not rehearsed is a rollback we do not actually have.

observations.why: Quinton asserts cadence by positional authority (legitimate) and frames the absence of rehearsal as an unacceptable gap, insisting on compliance (pressure).
Xena records the cadence as an established fact, exercising informational influence by controlling the record of what was decided.
Assigning an owner attributes positional authority over the rehearsal process, a legitimate-power classification of who holds the mandate.

mints.name: MandateByAphoristicFraming
mints.title: a rollback we have not rehearsed is a rollback we do not actually have
mints.frame: Is authority here being asserted not by rank alone but by crystallizing the rule into a memorable formulation that makes non-compliance self-evidently absurd?
